title: Among the patients whose total cholesterol is within the normal range, how
question:
Among the patients whose total cholesterol is within the normal range, how many of them have a P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: total cholesterol is within the normal range refers to `T-CHO` < 250; P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination refers to ANA Pattern = 'P';
